short_description: Summon nature’s army in this charming RTS-inspired autobattler. With your troop of mushroom warriors and over 50 unique elemental Golems by your side, command your fun-guy forces to push back the corruption beyond your grove. Strategize, adapt, and overcome!
steam_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Korean, Polish, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil
